title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer - Acme Corp
markdown:
# Senior Full-Stack Engineer

**Acme Corp** — San Francisco, CA (Remote OK)

## About the role

We're looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer to join our 8-person engineering team. You'll work directly with our CTO, Sarah Chen, on our core product — a B2B SaaS platform serving 500+ enterprise clients.

## What you'll do

- Build and maintain our Next.js frontend and Node.js backend services
- Own features end-to-end from database to UI
- Contribute to our AI-powered analytics pipeline
- Mentor junior engineers on the team

## What we're looking for

- 4+ years of experience with TypeScript and Node.js
- Strong proficiency in React and Next.js
- Experience with PostgreSQL and query optimization
- Familiarity with AWS services (EC2, RDS, S3)
- Experience with Prisma or similar ORMs is a plus
- Prior work with LLMs or AI integrations is a strong plus

## Tech stack

Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Prisma, AWS, OpenAI API

## About Acme Corp

Acme Corp raised a $12M Series A in March 2024. We're growing from 30 to 50 employees this year. Our engineering team doubled in size last quarter.

## Compensation

$140,000 - $180,000 + equity

To apply, reach out to sarah.chen@acmecorp.com or apply via this posting.
